People: Charles de Secondat Montesquieu (author, Wikidata Q15975), died 1755; André Lefèvre (notes, Wikidata Q4260364), died 1904. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Montesquieu, Charles de Secondat, baron de, 1689-1755; Lefèvre, André, 1834-1904 [Annotator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Lettres persanes : le temple de Gnide, Paris : Flammarion, 1907, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lettrespersanesl00mont. The scan does not show the credit of André Lefèvre, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
